changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO payroll.pay_component (business_id, component_code, component_name, component_type, proration_basis, share_scope, applies_to, display_order) SELECT b.business_id, v.code, v.name, 'EARNING', 'NONE', v.scope::payroll.share_scope, v.applies_to::payroll.applies_to, v.ord FROM identity.business b CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('SALARY_SUPPLEMENT', 'Phụ cấp bù lương', 'LINE', 'BOTH', 15), ('BIRTHDAY_ALLOWANCE', 'Phụ cấp sinh nhật', 'EMPLOYEE', 'BOTH', 90) ) AS v(code, name, scope, applies_to, ord) ON CONFLICT (business_id, component_code) DO NOTHING;
